summary: Pre-trial difficulty design is genuine coupled event-time session reasoning, not clerical file volume or obscure trivia. Session identity, pre-update watermark lateness, monotonic journal restart, CLI fail-closed mutation order, --input vs --feed gap semantics, and catalog gap overlay interact so local patches stay globally wrong. Official GPT×5+Claude×5 tier is UNMEASURED / NOT_MEASURABLE.

evidence.observation: Work request states interacting end-state invariants (event-time sessions, tenant+user keys, gap/lateness/watermark, journal restart, CLI exit 2 before mutation, catalog overlay, empty-input no watermark advance) without naming defective modules or a repair recipe.

Binding contract sequences lateness against the pre-update watermark, then max_observed/journal, then watermark-triggered closes; restart must restore seq/max_observed/opens with nondecreasing journaled watermark_ms.

Incident notes mixed-tenant same user_id, late events classified on-time after a high anchor, journal rewrite/seq stuck at 1, and --reset-output wiping the journal—symptoms that must be reconciled together, not a file checklist.

Captured run shows journal rewrite path with seq=1, f3/f4 classified on_time after a 100000 anchor, restart restore from a collapsed max_observed, --reset-output clearing the journal, and an unknown flag still creating watermark.journal.
Starter drops tenant_id and keys only on user_id, so acme/beta u1 share one session; fixing this alone does not restore late-vs-on-time or journal monotonicity.
record() assigns the current event_time instead of observe(max, event), so a later low timestamp can drop max_observed even if classify order is later repaired.
Starter records/updates max_observed before classify_lateness and defaults use_arrival_gap=True, violating the contract's compare-then-update order and event-time gap rule.
append_journal overwrites the file with seq always 1; load can restore max_observed, but restart still cannot keep prefix, seq, or nondecreasing watermarks.
Runtime touch and --reset-output journal wipe happen before argparse, so unknown/missing flags mutate state; CLI also always passes use_arrival_gap=True even for --input.
On-time close still has an arrival-index gap path; leaving CLI/pipeline use_arrival_gap true makes --input event-time sort a local fix that still gap-closes wrong.
Catalog enterprise overlay of session_gap_ms is already wired; a solver who globally retunes processor.json gap to 45000 heals the catalog holdout and breaks lab gap closes.
Oracle replaces five interacting modules (session_key, journal, pipeline, cli, watermark_track) then drives the public CLI—not a golden-output dump.

Independent F2P/P2P families cover CLI fail-closed, half-open gap, tenant isolation, journal seq/prefix/monotonicity, late-allowed vs TOO_LATE, restart, config mutation, --input tie-break vs --feed order, catalog enterprise idle-close, and holdout sessions; presence/warehouse checks are ancillary, not the scored hardness.

findings.why_it_matters: Packet state is PRE_LLMAJ and Harbor LLMaJ plus official 10 trials are deferred; no complete-run pass rate or per-test solvability exists, so DIFFICULTY_VERDICT cannot be a final Edition 3 tier.
findings.minimal_remediation: After Pre-LLMaJ/Harbor maturity, run GPT-5.5 ×5 and Claude Opus 4.8 ×5 and set DIFFICULTY_VERDICT from the combined complete-run mean; do not invent trial stats now.
findings.regression_risk: None for design PASS; empirical tier may differ from this design judgment.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction plus contract enumerate the end-state rules, and the bounce log names journal rewrite, on_time misclassification, reset wiping the journal, and unknown-flag mutation. A strong agent may spec-implement the five modules without deep diagnosis. That raises shortcut risk but does not make the work clerical: watermark-before-classify, overwrite-vs-max, append-vs-rewrite, CLI parse order, and arrival-gap vs event-time still interact, and holdouts/config mutation reject hardcoded public fixtures.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep coupled counterexamples and holdouts. Do not further flatten the instruction into a per-file repair list. Recalibrate shortcut risk from official trajectories if pass rate is unexpectedly high.
findings.regression_risk: Low if hidden holdouts and restart/lateness families remain independent.

findings.why_it_matters: The agent tree contains many already-correct helpers (classify, close, catalog overlay, ingest order). Difficulty is not the LOC count. A solver who hunts every module may waste time, but the minimum successful chain is diagnosis of the five coupled defects plus contract-faithful event-time behavior.
findings.minimal_remediation: Do not add extra unrelated files to inflate perceived difficulty. Do not treat warehouse dump size as a reasoning bottleneck.

missing_evidence: Combined 10-trial per-test solvability matrix and trajectories
do_not_change: Do not collapse tenant key, watermark update order, journal append/seq, CLI fail-closed mutation, and --input vs --feed gap semantics into a single-module bug to chase early pass rate.
Do not treat surrounding helper/warehouse LOC as the difficulty signal.
Do not assign a final Edition 3 tier before combined official 10 trials.
next_gate: Continue Pre-LLMaJ / Harbor path; defer official model trials for empirical tier

REASONING_CHAIN_ESTIMATE: Diagnose mixed-tenant sessions, backward/rewritten watermark journal, late events classified on-time, --reset-output wiping journal, and unknown-flag mutation from oncall, bounce log, contract, and public CLI runs
Restore session identity as (tenant_id, user_id) so same user_id under different tenants never share opens, late-join eligibility, or closes
Classify lateness against the pre-update comparison watermark, then observe max_observed with a true max so a later low event cannot drop the watermark or journal it backwards
Persist watermark.journal as append-only increasing seq; reload next_seq and max_observed; keep --reset-output from touching journal or open-session snapshot

Parse/validate CLI before any journal or output mutation; unknown flags or omitted --input/--feed/--empty-check exit 2; --input event-time tie-break vs --feed file order; event-time gap not arrival-index gap

Honor processor.json knobs plus catalog enterprise session_gap overlay for watermark idle close; empty input leaves sessions/late empty without journal advance; reject malformed into rejects.jsonl; refresh last_run.json and ops-report.json from the warehouse catalog without rewriting the click dump
role_output.PER_TEST_COVERAGE: Oracle/NOP only; official 10-trial solvability not yet measured
